svg.title: Kamu Evrak
svg.desc: Kamu Evrak — public-sector paperwork · team TasnifX. Agents read, classify (19 types), check and draft official correspondence for human sign-off, with a rule-based fallback behind every LLM step. 76% usable output (up from 22%); ~7 s per document (~$0.001 each); 3.4k tests. Stack: FastAPI, LangGraph, React, RapidOCR.
